additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Additional clinical information which was collected from participants is documented in the CARMS trial protocol and included general psychiatric symptoms, positive and negative psychotic symptoms, drug and alcohol use, and, dependent on allocation condition, therapy process variables (e.g., number of therapy sessions, time in therapy) [ 13 ].
additional_units.result_quote: The mean number of therapy sessions received by these 11 participants was 17.64 (SD = 6.89, Range = 0-24).

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Furthermore, as the overall study aim was about suicidal experiences, it was important to sample participants with a range of scores on baseline measures of suicidal thoughts and attempts.
additional_units.result_quote: Fourteen participants had made more than one suicide attempt throughout their life and five had made one attempt.
